fusions.name: Dewdrop Shot
fusions.desc: Rolls a bead of water off your leaves into one enemy for 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pondweed Mat
fusions.desc: Spreads a mat of floating weed under every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 7 damage with a 60% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill restores one.

fusions.name: Lotus Sheen
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 60% chance to roll off and land on whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Lily Pad Footing

riders.text: you move faster over water than over ground
and you recover mana faster while you stand on it
and you are harder to hit while you stand on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
